{{Top|leg}}
The '''Campus COMPNOR Cadre''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-affiliated organization that was based at the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]]. [[Titus Klev]], who had served in both [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|SAGroup]] and [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] before entering the Academy benefited from his association with the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] as he was the type of wholesome [[Human/Legends|Human]] that the propaganda branch liked to feature in media stories.
